notes.subject: שאון/ישאון
notes.rationale: Root שׁאה repeated: 'uproar' and 'they rush' — the nations become the noise itself; wordplay lost in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: וגער בו
notes.rationale: 'He rebukes him/it' — singular pronoun against plural nations; read as Yahwe rebuking the multitude, rendered with bracketed ⟨Em⟩.

notes.subject: גלגל
notes.rationale: 'rolling thing': tumbleweed (KJV/BSB) vs whirling dust (ASV/JPS); rendered 'wilwil' (a thing that rolls).

notes.subject: ruak
notes.rationale: רוח rendered 'ruak' — wind/breath/Spirit as one word, per discipline.

notes.subject: sudden disappearance
notes.rationale: Verse withholds the agent of the rebuke — the destroyer is unnamed, only His effect shown.

translation: Ol lain olgeta i raning olsem nois bilong planti wara, tasol ⟨Em⟩ i skruim tok long em, na em i ranawe i go longpela hap, na ol i stingim ⟨ol⟩ i go olsem pas bilong ol maunten long front bilong ruak, na olsem wanpela wilwil long front bilong bikpela win guria.
